```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

## Population growth by state

This chart compares state populations in 2019 and 2023 and calculates the percent change over that period.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
population_2019 <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(population = "B01003_001"),
  year = 2019,
  survey = "acs1"
)

population_2023 <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(population = "B01003_001"),
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs1"
)
```

```{r}
population_change <- population_2019 |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, population_2019 = estimate) |>
  inner_join(
    population_2023 |>
      select(GEOID, population_2023 = estimate),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percent_change = (population_2023 - population_2019) /
      population_2019 * 100
  )

population_change |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = percent_change,
    y = fct_reorder(NAME, percent_change)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Population Growth by State, 2019 to 2023",
    x = "Population change",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2019 and 2023 ACS 1-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Median household income by state

This chart shows median household income across states in 2023.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
# Fetch 2023 median household income (B19013_001) for each state
income_2023 <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(median_income = "B19013_001"),
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs1"
)
```

```{r}
income_2023 |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = estimate,
    # Reorder state names from lowest to highest income
    y = fct_reorder(NAME, estimate)
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "#41AB5D") +
  # Format the x-axis numbers as dollar amounts
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by State, 2023",
    x = "Median household income",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2023 ACS 1-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Population growth and median household income

This chart compares each state's population change (2019–2023) with its 2023 median household income to explore how population growth relates to economic prosperity.

```{r}
#| message: false
# Join population change and 2023 median income for each state
growth_and_income <- population_change |>
  inner_join(
    income_2023 |>
      select(GEOID, median_income = estimate),
    by = "GEOID"
  )

growth_and_income |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percent_change, y = median_income)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2C7FB8", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add a linear trend line to show the overall relationship
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#253494", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "State Population Growth vs. Median Household Income",
    subtitle = "Comparing 2019–2023 population change with 2023 median household income",
    x = "Population change (2019 to 2023)",
    y = "Median household income (2023)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2019 and 2023 ACS 1-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
